inclusivity_rules: Use respectful identity and disability terminology appropriate to the locale.
Do not infer personal gender or add stereotypes.
Preserve vernacular and character identity unless a reviewer approves adaptation.
prohibited_claims: Do not add guarantees, medical efficacy claims, legal conclusions, or unsupported superlatives.

channel_rules.ui: Prefer concise action-led labels and preserve accessible names and declared limits.
channel_rules.marketing: Preserve approved claims and document transcreation rationale and back-translation.
channel_rules.technical: Preserve identifiers, commands, warnings, cross-references, and procedural order.
channel_rules.subtitles: Preserve speaker, sound cues, timing, reading speed, and line limits.
channel_rules.easy-language: Use explicit short steps without weakening required terms or safety.
